$comment: The document is a post (contract/collections/posts.json) as the post view receives it: title, href, date (from publishedAt, in the site's time zone), readingMinutes, author resolved, and its layout split as section#sections-in-a-post draws it: body is the rich-text section that is prose alone, and sections[0] is the one section of the layout that draws as a band, with its field values as stored and its plan (track, index). One band per case, as the fixtures gate nests one section; post/band-* together use each section a post allows. The prose comes first in the layout.
summary: A post whose layout is prose and then a call to action: the prose draws bare in the article at base 1, and the call to action draws as a band after it, its heading h2 under the post's h1 (section#sections-in-a-post).

document.title: Open day on the farm
document.body: We open the gates on Saturday 9 May. Walk the beds, meet the team and take home a tray of seedlings.

values.heading: Book your place
values.body: Places are free, but we need numbers for the tea.
